encodings.json: every value the reference produced or was given (results, thrown properties, operation params and answers, call params) is JSON text in a string field: <name>_json, or json in an entry; -0 is written -0 and ±Infinity ±1e400, which JSON.parse reads back as such; lone surrogates are escapes
encodings.undefined: a present undefined is a field of its own, <name>_undefined: true (undefined: true in an entry), never a value
encodings.entries: an object the router returned or threw is a list of { key, json | json_repeat | undefined } in property order
encodings.repeat: a text over 64 KiB is <field>_repeat: { head, unit, count, tail, length, sha256 }, the text being head + unit × count + tail (length in UTF-16 units, sha256 of its UTF-8)
encodings.plain: worlds, steps, state tables and the frames of the records are plain JSON the harness writes itself; a world's result_repeat is a repeat macro for a result string
encodings.times: virtual milliseconds after the scenario's start (Date.now() 1760000000000); in state tables 0 stays 0, the reference's unset
encodings.rpc_body: the request body as sent, with its id (Date.now()) replaced by 0
encodings.expect_settle_ms: on a call: how long after its start the ported test says it settles (expect_settle_max_ms: at most); generation fails otherwise
